column1: # Prayer times of every city in android/app/.../Cities.java from tests/adhan_port.mjs (a port of adhan-js 4.4.6, Batoul Apps, MIT), the independent reference for tests/prayer_crosscheck_test.py. Generated by tests/prayer_crosscheck_gen.mjs; do not edit by hand.
